summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. As of 30 April 2026, 600,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of €24.48 per share for a total consideration of €14.69 million, representing 1.47% completion by value. The programme aims to reduce share capital; no board recommendation, advisors, premium, or regulatory clock are mentioned. The buyback is open-market and part of the issuer's capital return plan. The risk-arb angle is minimal—watch for execution pace and potential impact on earnings per share.
